verses.2549: hadhā huwa l-ʾislāmu yajmaʿu baynanā wad-dīnu ʾaṣdaqu rābiṭi washiʿāri
verses.2550: faʾidhā l-masāfatu farraqat ʾajsāmanā faqulūbunā fī wiḥdati wakhiyāri
verses.2551: dīnu yuwaḥḥidu l-ʿaqīdata lā tarā jinsā ʿalā jinsi yafūqu lidāri
verses.2552: yuʿṭī l-ḥayāta salāmata waʾamānata wayabuththu rūḥa l-wuddi wal-ʾīthāri
verses.2553: zuʿamāʾu hadhā d-dīni qādatu qawmihi wallāhu yarʿākum madā l-ʾaʿmāri
verses.2554: tabnūna lidhā l-majdi ṣarkhā shāmikhā bil-ʿilmi wal-ʾirshādi wal-ʾadhkāri
verses.2555: faʾilaykumu ʾuhdī t-taḥḥiyata mithlamā yuhdī t-taḥḥiyata muslimu lil-jāri
verses.2556: wabimithlikum naʿtazzu nabghī daʿwata faʿasā lanā ʾatharu mina l-ʾāthāri
verses.2557: wallāha ʾasʾalu ʾan yuʿīda liqāʾanā was-saʿda kulla s-saʿdi fī l-ʾakhyāri
verses.2558: qalbī liruʾuyatikum ṣaḥā mutaʾalliqā fariḥā bikum fī multaqā l-ʾaqmāri
verses.2559: wamuʿammaru l-qadhdhāfi ʿammara dīnanā bijuhūdihi wabijūdihi l-midrāri
verses.2560: wallāhu yaḥfaẓuhu wayanṣuru shaʿbahu wayuqīmuhum min kulli sharri jāri
verses.2561: wal-muslimūna yudīmuhum fī wiḥdati wayazīduhum qadrā ʿalā l-ʾaqdāri
verses.2562: bil-muṣṭafā wal-ʾāli wal-ʾaṣḥābi man qad hājarū wal-ʾikhwati l-ʾanṣāri
verses.2563: waʿalayhimu ʾazkā ṣ-ṣalāti maʿa s-salā mi yaʿʿumuhum min rabbinā l-jabbāri
verses.2564: mā qāla manṣūru bibaḥri kāmili wad-dīnu ʾaṣdaqu rābiṭi washiʿāri
